title: Cascade: Sortimentstiefe Spills

The carousel spins violently, scattering a flurry of identical price tags that slap onto the monster's leaves and add weight, causing it to stumble.

title: Rupture: Sortimentsbreite Breaks Out
event: The stuck elevator triggers its emergency venting: the doors shudder and a tensioned shutter drops, dumping a mixed cascade of assorted wide-format goods (different sizes and colors) onto the 'Reuterkiez' banner. The monster leaps onto the gondola and its movement spins it faster; a hanging lamp chain snags on the gondola, yanking a skylight duct panel loose — the duct pops open with a gust that blows a wide fan of price stickers and flyers across the sales floor, painting a broad swath of varied color (a literal Sortimentsbreite).

title: Consequence: Kreuzkölln Mosaic
event: The fan of stickers and the spilled assortment sweep toward the front tile area. They collect into a rough mosaic over an exposed tile patch; under the weight a single tile pops up to reveal a warm amber light beneath and the assembled stickers briefly form the word 'Kreuzkölln'. The monster peels a glowing seed from its leaf and drops it into the open tile socket; the seed sprouts instantly into a small green shoot that wedges the tile slightly higher and emits a soft pulse. The shop's hidden PA stutters to life on that pulse, broadcasting a warped radio jingle that mutters 'Berlin-Kreuzberg' as all the hanging lamps synchronize one blink and then dim, freezing the store into a resolved tableau.
